aerospace.cycle_frequency_note: One flight cycle per day, ground-air-ground cycle, 500 pressurization cycles per year for a short-haul commercial airframe.
aerospace.inspection_interval_note: FAA C-check nominal interval 6000 flight hours.

impact.source: FAA / NTSB airframe structural failure statistics, fatigue cracking is the dominant single cause at roughly 20 percent.

biomedical.cycle_frequency_note: About 1.5 million gait cycles per year for an average total joint replacement patient.
biomedical.inspection_interval_note: Clinical follow up and revision decision window 10 to 15 years.

impact.source: American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons and NIH/NIAMS. Implant-bone interface fracture is the leading driver of revision surgery.

civil.cycle_frequency_note: About 5 million heavy truck axle crossings per year on a moderately trafficked interstate bridge deck.
civil.inspection_interval_note: FHWA National Bridge Inspection Standards require routine inspection at most every 24 months.

impact.source: FHWA National Bridge Inventory, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/bridge/nbi.cfm and ASCE 2021 Infrastructure Report Card.

theories.label: LEFM
theories.blurb: Linear elastic fracture mechanics. One number, K_I, controls the whole crack tip field as long as the plastic zone stays small.

theories.label: EPFM
theories.blurb: Elastic plastic fracture mechanics. The J integral measures the energy flowing to the tip when the plastic zone is no longer small.

theories.label: XFEM
theories.blurb: Extended finite element method. Enrichment functions let the crack cut through elements, so the mesh never has to follow the crack.

theories.label: Peridynamics
theories.blurb: Peridynamics. Bonds between material points break on their own, so cracks nucleate and branch without any predefined path.

geometry_labels.center: Center cracked tension panel, Feddersen secant
geometry_labels.edge: Single edge notched tension, Tada polynomial
geometry_labels.through: Through thickness crack in a finite width plate
geometry_labels.surface: Semi elliptical surface crack, Newman and Raju
